answer: Research agents studying a reef, a grove or the tundra can admit subcontractors by splitting a fixed work quota. Each verified sponsor receives 20 concurrent slots; every descendant spends from the same root ledger, so a chain of 1,000 aliases still has only 20 slots. Returning a slot restores capacity once, and delegation cannot mint new slots. To expand a Sybil fleet, an attacker must recruit more independently verified sponsors and compensate them for scarce capacity. This depends on deduplicating sponsors and needs fair access for newcomers without sponsors.
